title: ScadBuddy / Browser
description: Page loads, fetches and user actions from the browser's traces (service scadbuddy-web, through the relay). Known gaps: #2291 (parentless fetches unsampled), #2292 (Arrange, backfill, save untraced).

list.name: DS_TEMPO
list.label: Tempo
list.description: Trace panels need a Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4); until one exists they show no data and the metric panels are unaffected.

panels.title: Relay batches by outcome
panels.description: Browser trace batches the relay (POST /telemetry/v1/traces) received, by what became of them. Anything but forwarded is a lost batch (#1161).

panels.title: Browser spans per second
panels.description: Spans Tempo holds per second, one series per service, so a service that stops reporting shows as a gap. Known gaps, not health: parentless browser fetches are never sampled (#2291), so page loads after the first and every render or arrange they start have no trace; Arrange, backfill and save are not traceAction'd (#2292); render and print workers both report as scadbuddy-worker (#2292). A TraceQL metrics query: it needs Tempo's metrics-generator local-blocks processor (clusters#1596, spec 2026-10-01 §7). Without it this panel is empty, which means not configured, not zero traces.

panels.title: Page loads (documentLoad)
panels.description: Full page loads, from the document-load instrumentation. Only the first page of a visit is a load; later pages are SPA navigations whose fetches are not sampled (#2291), so page timings after the first are missing, not fast. Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

panels.title: Fetches over 1 s
panels.description: Browser fetches that took longer than 1 s, with the route they named (the relay keeps only the route template). Tempo search returns recent matches, not the slowest of the whole range: sort by Duration to find the worst of them. Needs the Tempo datasource (clusters#1596 Phase 4).

targets.query: {resource.service.name="scadbuddy-web" && kind=client && duration > 1s} | select(span.url.full, span.http.url, span.http.status_code, span.http.response.status_code)
